name: Cupid's Bargain
source:
A self-proclaimed matchmaker who has never experienced love summons a pair of demonic deities to spruce up her dying school extracurricular because, like, who really needs a soul anyway? Together, they will settle a toxic love affair disturbing her school life all while helping her understand love itself...

...and selling souls in the meantime. 

[From [url=https://miseri-accordion.itch.io/cupids-bargain]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个自称从未经历过爱情的媒人召唤了一对恶魔神灵来美化她垂死的学校课外活动，因为，谁真的需要灵魂呢？他们将共同解决一场扰乱她学校生活的有毒恋情，同时帮助她理解爱情本身……

……同时出卖灵魂。

[来自[url=https://miseri-accordion.itch.io/cupids-bargain]itch.io[/url]]
